summary: The target-only flag optimization preserves the intended target assignment in the divided-file builder, but it silently breaks the new diagnostic’s census-membership analysis. The diagnostic now profiles all non-target records as though they were absent from the labeled census; fix it to merge against the complete labeled-ID universe rather than the target-only flag.

findings.title: The diagnostic misclassifies every labeled non-target record as absent from the labeled census
findings.what_the_code_does: The optimized builder executes `keep if tgt` before saving `tgt_flag1940.dta`, so that file contains only target IDs. The diagnostic then loads those IDs, retains divided-file records with `_merge==1`, and labels them `Divided-file records not in census1940_all_labeled_data.dta`. `_merge==1` now means `not in the target-only flag`, which includes both genuinely absent records and every labeled record with `tgt==0`.
findings.why_it_matters: The claimed diagnostic of the 4,819,575 records outside the labeled census is no longer computed. Its count and age/birthplace profile will instead be dominated by ordinary labeled non-target records, potentially misleading the decision about whether treating genuinely unmatched records as non-target is defensible. The counts in the brief imply that tens of millions could be misclassified, although the exact revised count requires the external data.
findings.how_to_check: Run the diagnostic once with `ids` constructed from all `histid` values in `census1940_all_labeled_data.dta` and once from `tgt_flag1940.dta`; compare `nn` and the age/birthplace tables. Alternatively, on one divided file, merge IDs separately against the complete labeled-ID list and the target-only flag, then count observations unmatched only in the latter.
findings.suggested_fix: In `tgt_fallback_diag.do`, construct `ids` directly from all `histid` values in `census1940_all_labeled_data.dta`, rename `histid` to `id`, and assert uniqueness before the merge. Keep `tgt_flag1940.dta` target-only for speed in the production builder, but do not use it as a proxy for census membership.

verified_clean.item: The target-only flag optimization leaves production target assignments unchanged.
verified_clean.evidence: The builder saves only observations satisfying `tgt`, then assigns `tgt=0` to every master record unmatched in that file. Thus target IDs remain one and all other divided-file IDs become zero at MATCHING/1c_tgt_divided_files.do:54-65 and MATCHING/1c_tgt_divided_files.do:100-103.

verified_clean.item: The target definition still matches the canonical analysis expression.
verified_clean.evidence: The builder uses `!(namefrst==namefrst_fs & namelast==namelast_fs)` at MATCHING/1c_tgt_divided_files.do:52-54, matching MATCHING/fs_avg_performance.do:79-83.

verified_clean.item: The divided-file sources must have identical file sets, unique IDs, and record membership.
verified_clean.evidence: Sorted filename lists are compared at MATCHING/1c_tgt_divided_files.do:71-78; both inputs are checked with `isid id`, and their merge requires `assert(3)` at MATCHING/1c_tgt_divided_files.do:91-100.

verified_clean.item: The fallback-discrepancy diagnostic accumulates qualifying records across files without losing earlier batches.
verified_clean.evidence: Each nonempty batch appends the previously saved tempfile before replacing it at MATCHING/tgt_fallback_diag.do:35-41.

verified_clean.item: The diagnostic separates missing ages from the age-10-plus category correctly.
verified_clean.evidence: The age categories use `age<10`, `age>=10 & age<.`, and `age>=.` at MATCHING/tgt_fallback_diag.do:78-83, avoiding Stata's missing-value comparison trap.

verified_clean.item: The builder protects both its destination directory and flag file before writing.
verified_clean.evidence: Existence checks halt before target construction or output creation at MATCHING/1c_tgt_divided_files.do:32-42.

verified_clean.item: No new estimator, treatment assignment, inference procedure, or identification claim was introduced.
verified_clean.evidence: The executable changes are limited to shrinking a target-ID merge input and adding descriptive diagnostics; the production substitution remains at MATCHING/1c_tgt_divided_files.do:111-124.

review_limits: No paper draft was supplied, so paper claims could not be checked against the code; claims-vs-code review was limited to assertions in the changed scripts and review brief.
The external census and divided-file data were unavailable in the repository, so exact affected counts and generated diagnostic tables could not be independently calculated.
The Stata pipeline was not executed; runtime consequences are inferred from the source and Stata merge semantics.
This was a diff-scoped review of the uncommitted working tree, including all untracked files reported by `git status --short`, not a full-repository audit.
